dedupe_keys.name: cogtd the national high resolution 1m dataset of oil and gas storage tanks in china 2019 2025

description: Yuchi Xing and colleagues at Wuhan University and partner organisations publish COGTD, an inventory of 76,635 onshore oil and gas storage tanks across China. They derive detections from GF satellite imagery and describe ten attributes covering coordinates, geometry, shape, industry type and administrative location. The title identifies imagery coverage during 2019–2025 at one-metre or finer resolution. The December 2025 Zenodo release is free under CC BY 4.0. Its file inventory also lists tank-emission archives and NetCDF methane layers, whose calculation methods and units were not established here. These asset locations can support infrastructure-exposure and storage-distribution simulations. Detected tank geometry does not by itself establish working capacity, contents or operational status, and detection accuracy was not independently assessed. No related catalogue record explicitly covers COGTD. The archives and grids were not downloaded.
